description: Run the full 5-node atomic deconstruction pipeline (Ingestion → Sanitization → Tokenization → Classification → Serialization) on resume text. Returns stage-by-stage metrics, confidence scores, entity classification with disambiguation, data quality assessment, and assumption audit. Use this to understand HOW the parser processes a resume and WHERE confidence is low.
